acts.desc: After hearing about the heist, Kirk Wallace Johnson gets sucked into the feather underground. He ends up discovering things that the people in charge of the theft investigation didn’t. Kirk’s book about the heist is called “ The Feather Thief. "
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: The birds Edwin Rist stole were valuable and collected in the mid-1800s by one of the greatest scientific explorers of his time: a man named Alfred Russel Wallace.
acts.title: The Specimens

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Edwin's life in a rarified world of flutes and feathers.
acts.title: The Flautist

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Edwin visits a branch of Britain's Natural History Museum in a little town called Tring. (3 1/2 minutes)
acts.title: The Museum

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: The detective on the case takes Kirk to the crime scene.
acts.title: The Heist

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: The police track Edwin down after a fly-tier turns in a tip. (6 1/2 minutes)
acts.title: The Investigation

acts.label: Act Six
acts.desc: Kirk wonders if Edwin has a sidekick who helped him the night of the Tring heist.
acts.title: The Suspect

acts.label: Act Seven
acts.desc: In Norway, Kirk tracks down fugitive feathers.
acts.title: Oslo
